$Comment: A boss bomb's blast, shared by every boss in this pack: each player within 3 blocks takes the game's own Fire damage, a shove and the game's own Burn. The one hit rule matches Player only, so the boss who threw it and his own creatures are never hurt by it; it is a creature's blast, so the world's PvP setting never filters it. IgnoreOwner skips the thrower whatever the rule says. A boss's projectile names this blast as it lands; Orbis_Boss_Bomb_Burst_Heavy is the bigger one for falling volleys. Range is the radius in blocks; BaseDamage and Knockback.Force set how hard it hits.
